executive_summary.headline: Shanghai Late-February 2027 Couple's MICHELIN & Cultural Travel Blueprint
executive_summary.destination_verdict: Shanghai is Mainland China's undisputed #1 base for a subway-connected MICHELIN couple's vacation: 50 active Starred restaurants (1×3★, 12×2★, 37×1★) and 154 total MICHELIN Guide venues sit inside a single compact Metro grid where 47 to 50 Starred restaurants are reachable within ≤60 minutes door-to-door for RMB 3–4 ($0.45–$0.60) per person.
executive_summary.date_verdict: Start RIGHT ON your preferred Mon Feb 15, 2027 date (Feb 15 – Feb 22, 2027) or shift 1 week to Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1, 2027. Official PRC State Council holidays confirm Spring Festival Golden Week ends Sat Feb 13, 2027 (make-up workday Sun Feb 14). Live 2027 hotel rate queries prove Feb 15–Mar 1 is 26%–35% ($302–$877 per 7 nights) CHEAPER at 5-star hotels than March 8–15, 2027!

sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.theme: Arrival, Early-Evening Bund Lights & Creekside Night Art
sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.plan: Ride Suburban Airport Link (RMB 26/adult) + Line 2 to hotel. Stroll The Bund 17:30–19:00 (winter lights switch off at 21:00!). Casual French dinner at Selected Mr & Mrs Bund (open til 22:30) or late gallery date at Fotografiska Suzhou Creek (open Mon until 23:00 while most museums close Mondays).

09:00 opening entry at Yu Garden (CNY 80/couple — beating Sat Feb 20 Lantern Festival crowds!) + Bib Gourmand Nanxiang soup dumplings. Afternoon walk through Xintiandi Shikumen lanes; dinner at 2★ T'ang Court (CNY 888 lunch or CNY 2,288 signature dinner).

sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.theme: Shanghai Museum East National Treasures & Lujiazui Supertalls
sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.plan: Morning Line 2 to Shanghai Museum East (Free w/ passport; open Wed–Mon 10:00–18:00 — hosts permanent Chinese bronzes/ceramics!). Lunch at 1★ Yong Yi Ting (Mandarin Oriental Pudong). Sunset at Top of Shanghai 118F + evening galleries at Jean Nouvel's Museum of Art Pudong (open til 21:00).
Metro Line 8/10 -> Line 11 (~52 min) to Shanghai Disney Resort on a low-crowd post-holiday Thursday (Regular-tier pricing vs weekend surge; bring physical passports for entry!).

sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.theme: French Concession Lanes & 3★ Taian Table Chef's Counter
sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.plan: Morning Jade Buddha Temple (08:00–16:30, beating Saturday Lunar 15th incense rush) + Tianzifang artisan lanes & Polux café lunch in Xintiandi. 18:30 intimate counter dinner at 3★ Taian Table (Line 2 Jiangsu Rd; book ≥30 days ahead).

sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.theme: Americas Special Exhibit, Bvlgari Creek Views & Illuminated River Cruise
sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.plan: Morning Shanghai Museum People's Square ('Ancient Civilizations of the Americas'). Lunch at 1★ Il Ristorante - Niko Romito (Bvlgari 47F). 18:30 Shiliupu Wharf 50-min Huangpu River Cruise (avoiding Yuyuan Bazaar's peak Lantern Festival cordon crush!).

sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.theme: Bund Peninsula Dim Sum & Farewell Steakhouse / Bund Rooftop
sample_7_night_itinerary_feb15_22.plan: 1★ Yi Long Court Cantonese dim sum lunch at The Peninsula, RMB 2 public Huangpu Ferry crossing, afternoon spa/pool at hotel, and farewell dinner at Selected Sir Elly's rooftop or 1515 West Chophouse.

confirmed_knowns: Party & Room: 2 adults, 1 Queen or King bed, private en-suite bathroom.
Window: Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 (preferred start Mon Feb 15, 2027).
Holiday Coast-is-Clear: 2027 PRC Spring Festival runs Feb 5–13 (make-up workday Feb 14); Feb 15 avoids Golden Week domestic rush.
Hotel Sweet Spot: Late Feb (Feb 15–22 or Feb 22–Mar 1) is 26%–35% cheaper than March 2027 across Shanghai 5-star hotels.
Transit Feasibility: All 7 ranked hotels reach 47–50 Starred MICHELIN restaurants and all 12 core activities in ≤60 min by Metro/bus.
critical_unknowns: Exact trip duration (7-night benchmark vs 3–4 night stopover vs 10–14 night multi-city China trip).
Passport nationalities & onward third-country flight routing (determines whether NIA 240h visa-free transit applies or a Chinese L-Visa is needed after Dec 31, 2026).
Total target budget ceiling (especially Starred fine-dining wine pairings & international airfare from departure hub).
Dietary restrictions, allergies, or vegetarian/pescatarian preferences (unlocks 2★ vegetarian Fu He Hui vs seafood/wagyu menus).
Whether both travelers have Alipay + WeChat Pay linked to foreign Visa/Mastercard and non-VOIP roaming/eSIM configured.

pre_decision_questions.question: Which passports do both travelers hold, and will your flights route Country A -> Shanghai -> Country B (a third country/region incl. HK, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, or Korea) within ≤240 hours (10 days), or fly round-trip Country A <-> Shanghai?
pre_decision_questions.why_it_matters: China's unilateral 30-day visa-free policy is officially slated to expire Dec 31, 2026 unless extended by MFA, whereas NIA's 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit (57 countries incl. US/CA/UK/EU/AU) remains active IF flying onward to a third country/region (e.g., US -> Shanghai -> Tokyo/Hong Kong -> US).
pre_decision_questions.discovery_action: Check MFA/Embassy extension notices in Dec 2026 – Jan 2027 (`china-embassy.gov.cn`). If flying round-trip US <-> Shanghai without a third-country leg and holding US/CA/non-extended passports, apply for a 10-year L-Visa via COVA ≥45 days before Feb 15 (by Dec 31, 2026) — OR book your return via Seoul/Tokyo/Hong Kong to qualify automatically for 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit!

pre_decision_questions.question: Are you planning a single-base 7-night Shanghai stay (our pricing baseline), a shorter 4–5 night culinary sprint, or splitting 8–10 nights between Shanghai + Beijing/Hangzhou by high-speed rail?
pre_decision_questions.why_it_matters: Multi-night 10% hotel discounts kick in at 3+ to 7+ nights (e.g., Crowne Plaza 3n Feb 15–18 is $346 vs 7n $839), and 240-hour visa-free transit allows cross-province travel across 24 provinces including Beijing & Zhejiang.
pre_decision_questions.discovery_action: Decide night count before Jan 15, 2027 while holding refundable Feb 15–22 and/or Feb 22–Mar 1 hotel reservations (free cancel through Feb 14, 2027).

pre_decision_questions.question: How many formal 2.5–3 hour Starred tasting-menu dinners (CNY 2,300–5,800 / $340–$860+ per couple) do you want versus relaxed Bib Gourmand / Selected lunches & bistros ($15–$150 per couple), and do either of you avoid shellfish, pork, offal, or alcohol?
pre_decision_questions.why_it_matters: 3★ Taian Table (intimate counter), 2★ Da Vittorio, and 2★ Fu He Hui release seats 30–60 days out and require credit-card deposits with strict 48–72h cancellation rules, whereas Bib Gourmand spots (`Da Hu Chun`, `Nanxiang`) are walk-in only.
pre_decision_questions.discovery_action: Pick 2–3 anchor Starred restaurants by Jan 10, 2027 (~35 days prior) and ask your booked hotel's English concierge (IHG / Radisson / Hyatt / Marriott) to place verified WeChat/Chope reservations and obtain current RMB set-menu PDFs for any restaurant with unpublished online pricing (`Bombana`, `Fu He Hui`, `Canton 8`, `Ling Long`).

pre_decision_questions.category: Hotel Style: Pure Value vs Perks vs 1-MICHELIN-Key Design
pre_decision_questions.question: Would you rather put $650–$2,050 of hotel savings directly into 3★/2★ tasting menus (`Crowne Plaza` $839 or `Radisson Blu Suite` $1,038), enjoy Xintiandi boutique luxury with free cocktails (`Andaz` $1,494), or splurge on a 1-MICHELIN-Key icon (`The Shanghai EDITION` $2,895)?
pre_decision_questions.why_it_matters: Every hotel in our top 6 shares virtually identical 10–25 min Metro access to Shanghai's culinary core — the $2,056 spread between #3 Crowne Plaza ($839) and #2 EDITION ($2,895) buys three 3★/2★ tasting dinners for two!
pre_decision_questions.discovery_action: Lock in 1–2 refundable Pay-at-Hotel / Free-Cancel Early Bird bookings in Nov–Dec 2026, compare international airfare in mid-Dec 2026, and cancel the backup room before Feb 10, 2027.

pre_decision_questions.category: China Digital Payment, Metro Tap & Maps Readiness
pre_decision_questions.question: Have both travelers verified passport ID inside Alipay & WeChat Pay and tested foreign contactless tap-to-ride plans?
pre_decision_questions.why_it_matters: Mainland China is ~98% cashless QR-code based (Alipay/WeChat Pay), Google Maps is offset/blocked without roaming/eSIM (Apple Maps & Amap English mode work accurately inside China), and ticket booths at museums/parks link directly to passport numbers.
pre_decision_questions.discovery_action: 14 days before departure: (1) Install Alipay & WeChat, upload passport verification, and bind two no-foreign-transaction-fee Visa/Mastercards; (2) Enable Alipay 'Transport -> Shanghai Metro QR' (or tap foreign Visa/Mastercard at upgraded Shanghai Metro gates); (3) Activate travel eSIM/international roaming so YouTube/Instagram/Gmail work seamlessly.

flagged_items.item: Feb 15, 2027 Post-Spring-Festival Restart vs Sat Feb 20, 2027 Lantern Festival Surge
flagged_items.finding: Official PRC State Council 2027 Holiday Circular confirms Spring Festival Golden Week ends Sat Feb 13, 2027 (with Sun Feb 14 as a make-up workday), so starting Mon Feb 15, 2027 avoids Golden Week closures! However, Lantern Festival falls on Sat Feb 20, 2027 — Yu Garden Bazaar enforces paid peak cordon tickets and extreme evening crowds.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Keep Feb 15–22, 2027 (lowest 5-star hotel rates!), but visit Yu Garden on Tue Feb 16 morning at 09:00 and spend Sat Feb 20 evening on the Huangpu River Cruise or Bund rooftop instead.

flagged_items.item: China 30-Day Unilateral Visa-Free Policy Expires Dec 31, 2026 (Before Feb 2027 Trip)
flagged_items.finding: PRC Embassy notices confirm the current 30-day unilateral visa-free policy runs through Dec 31, 2026 unless extended, and does NOT cover US/UK/Canadian ordinary passports. Meanwhile, NIA's 240-Hour (10-Day) Visa-Free Transit IS active for 57 countries (incl. US/CA/UK/EU/AU) when flying Country A -> Shanghai -> Third Country/Region (e.g., Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong).
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Verify passport nationality + flight routing before booking non-refundable fares: route onward via HK/Tokyo/Seoul for ≤10-day visa-free transit OR obtain a Chinese L-Visa if flying simple round-trip.

flagged_items.item: Hotel Night-Count Standard Standardized to Verified 7-Night Windows (Plus 3-Night Reference)
flagged_items.finding: Total trip nights were open-ended inside the 36-night Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 window. To ensure strict apples-to-apples hotel ranking, all 7 hotels were queried for exact 7-night total stays incl. taxes across three real 2027 windows (`Feb 15–22`, `Feb 22–Mar 1`, `Mar 8–15`), plus a 3-night `Feb 15–18` reference ($346 at Crowne Plaza).
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Confirm final night count; use the interactive dashboard calculator if shortening to 4–5 nights or extending to 10 nights.

flagged_items.item: Strict Separation of 'Currently Starred (1★–3★)' vs 'Guide-Listed (Bib Gourmand / Selected)'
flagged_items.finding: Travel blogs routinely mislabel Bib Gourmand and MICHELIN Selected venues as 'Michelin-starred.' Shanghai's live Guide has 50 Starred restaurants vs 104 Bib Gourmand + Selected venues (154 total). Every table and filter on this site separates Starred from Guide-Listed.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Use Bib Gourmand & Selected venues ($15–$150/couple) for lunches/casual nights and reserve Starred budgets ($104–$860+/couple) for signature evenings.

flagged_items.item: Phénix at The PuLi Excluded After Line-by-Line Verification Against Live 1★ Directory
flagged_items.finding: The PuLi Hotel's website copy still references Michelin-star dining at Phénix, but full verification across all 38 restaurants in the live Shanghai 1-Star MICHELIN directory confirmed Phénix no longer holds a Star in the active selection.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Excluded from our Starred dataset to prevent booking on outdated marketing copy; replaced with verified 1★ Le Comptoir de Pierre Gagnaire (Capella) & 1★ Il Ristorante - Niko Romito (Bvlgari).

flagged_items.item: Shanghai MICHELIN Guide April 2026 Ceremony Total (156) vs Live Nov 2026 Directory (154)
flagged_items.finding: MICHELIN's April 2026 ceremony press release announced 156 Shanghai restaurants (1×3★, 13×2★, 38×1★ = 52 Starred), whereas the live Nov 2026 online directory renders 154 active listings (1×3★, 12×2★, 37×1★ = 50 Starred) following 2 post-ceremony closures/delistings.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: All 18 restaurants in `data/restaurants.json` were verified individually on active Nov 2026 `guide.michelin.com` pages so zero closed venues appear in your plan.

flagged_items.item: Polux by Paul Pairet: Official Restaurant Site Lists 11:00 Opening vs MICHELIN Guide 10:00
flagged_items.finding: Paul Pairet's official site (`paulpairet.com/polux-info/`) states 'Open daily from 11am to 10pm', while `guide.michelin.com` lists '10:00-22:00'. Both official figures are preserved side-by-side.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Arrive at 11:00 AM or later for brunch/coffee in Xintiandi to avoid waiting outside before doors open.

flagged_items.action_for_couple: Never rely on guessed blog prices; official MICHELIN price-tier symbols (`¥` to `¥¥¥¥`) are shown for orientation, and your hotel concierge can confirm current seasonal RMB menus 30 days prior.

flagged_items.item: Radisson Blu 430 ft² Junior Suite Cheaper Than Standard Room ($1,038 vs $1,085) & Treasury Windowless Room Trap ($686 vs $836)
flagged_items.finding: At Radisson Blu New World (`Feb 15–22, 2027`), a 10% Multi-Night promo prices the 430 ft² `Junior Suite` (1 Queen, Free Cancel) at **$1,038**, beating the smaller 322 ft² `Superior Queen` (**$1,085** non-ref / **$1,179** flex)! Conversely, at 4-star `Treasury Hotel`, the headline **$686** rate is a **windowless** 193 ft² room; upgrading to a windowed `Treasure Cozy Queen` costs **$836** — just **$3 less** than 5-star IHG `Crowne Plaza` (**$839** w/ window, bathtub & indoor pool!).
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Book `Crowne Plaza` ($839) over `Treasury Hotel` ($836) for massive 5-star upgrade at virtually identical cost, or grab `Radisson Blu`'s $1,038 `Junior Suite` while promo inventory lasts.

flagged_items.item: The Shanghai EDITION March 2027 Promo Inventory Not Yet Open on Trip.com (~100-Day Horizon)
flagged_items.finding: For `Feb 15–22` and `Feb 22–Mar 1, 2027`, Trip.com offers a 10% China Travel Deal on The Shanghai EDITION (`Deluxe King` = **$2,895** total vs **$3,220** direct on MICHELIN Guide). For `Mar 8–15, 2027`, Trip.com's OTA block is not yet loaded (`Sold Out/Closed`), while MICHELIN Guide direct inventory is open at **$3,220**.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: If choosing March 2027 at EDITION, wait until ~95 days out (early Dec 2026) to check if the $2,895 10% OTA promo opens before paying $3,220.

flagged_items.item: Shanghai Museum on People's Square Hosts ZERO Permanent Chinese Displays Through Nov 14, 2027
flagged_items.finding: Official `shanghaimuseum.net` visitor guidelines confirm that from **July 9, 2026 – November 14, 2027**, the People's Square building hosts ONLY the special exhibition *On Top of the World Tree: Ancient Civilizations of the Americas*. All permanent Chinese bronzes, ceramics, jade, and calligraphy are exhibited at **Shanghai Museum East** (1952 Century Ave, Pudong — Line 2, ~16 min, Free walk-in, closed Tuesdays).
flagged_items.action_for_couple: Go to **Shanghai Museum East** (Wed–Mon) for classic Chinese national treasures; only visit People's Square (Tue–Sun) if you specifically want the Americas exhibition!

flagged_items.item: Winter Bund Skyline Lights Switch Off at 21:00 (Nov–Apr) & Suburban Water Town >60-Min Exclusion
flagged_items.finding: (1) Official Shanghai tourism guidelines confirm Bund & Lujiazui architectural lights run **17:00–21:00** from November through April (vs 19:00–22:00 in summer) — couples arriving after 21:00 after a late fine-dining seating find dark towers! (2) Popular **Zhujiajiao Water Town** requires ~68–78 min door-to-door on Metro Line 17 from People's Square, exceeding our strict ≤60-min transit threshold.
flagged_items.action_for_couple: View The Bund or board the Huangpu River Cruise at **18:00–19:30 BEFORE late dinner**, and keep core activities inside the ≤60-min urban Metro ring.
